        """Return the absolute offset of the first LF scanned, or -1.

        At most ``maximum`` bytes starting at ``start`` are inspected.  Tiny
        attribution parts are traversed without scanning past the requested
        window, which keeps repeated boundary probes linear.
        """
        if (type(start) is not int or type(maximum) is not int or
                start < 0 or maximum < 0 or start > self.total):
            raise ValueError("capture line range")
        stop = min(self.total, start + maximum)
        index = bisect_right(self.ends, start)
        cursor = start
        while index < len(self.parts) and cursor < stop:
            node = self.parts[index][1]
            part_start = self.starts[index]
            a = max(cursor, part_start)
            b = min(stop, self.ends[index])
            if a < b:
                take = b - a
                data = read_range(node, a - part_start, b - part_start, take)
                found = data.find(b"\\n")
                if found >= 0:
                    return a + found
                cursor = b
            index += 1
        return -1

'''
